messages.message: ### Step 1: Source-Reference Alignment & Semantic Analysis Task: Align source tokens to the provided Reference Translation; pick the correct in-context sense and grammatical role. Rules: be specific (no vague glosses); use the reference to resolve idioms/polysemy. Output: 1) ONE Markdown table columns: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] 2) Interpretation Lock (bullets; one per source line): - Line <ID> (copy exact source line): Locked Meaning: <truth-conditions> - If comparative/degree: state subject, comparator, relation (>, <, ≈) and DO NOT flip. Where <ID> is the leading integer at the start of that source line. Source Text: 1 Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita 2 mi ritrovai per una selva oscura, 3 ché la diritta via era smarrita. Reference Translation (provided): Midway upon the road of our life I found myself within a dark wood, for the right way had been missed.

**1️⃣ Alignment Table**
| Source Word | Morphology | Reference Equivalent | Contextual Definition | Grammatical Role | |------------|------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------| | **Nel** | preposition + definite article (in + the) | *Midway* (part of “Midway upon…”) | “in the middle of” – locative prepositional phrase introducing the central point | Prepositional article (forms a locative complex with *mezzo*) | | **mezzo** | noun, masculine singular, “middle” | *Midway* | The central point of a span; here the midpoint of life’s journey | Noun (head of the locative phrase) | | **del** | contraction of *di* + *il* (preposition + definite article) | *upon* (functionally “of the”) | “of the” – genitive linking the road to the larger context | Preposition + article (genitive marker) | | **cammin** | noun, masculine singular, archaic form of *cammino* “road, path” | *road* | The route or way that one travels on; metaphor for life’s course | Noun (direct object of the prepositional phrase) | | **di** | preposition “of” | *of* (in “of our life”) | Marks possession/association between “road” and “our life” | Preposition (genitive) | | **nostra** | possessive adjective, feminine singular “our” | *our* | Belonging to the speaker and companions; collective ownership of life | Adjective (modifies *vita*) | | **vita** | noun, feminine singular “life” | *life* | The span of existence of the speaker; the overall journey | Noun (head of the noun phrase) | | **mi** | reflexive pronoun, 1st‑person singular | *I* (subject) / *myself* (object) | The speaker referring to themselves; part of the reflexive construction | Reflexive object pronoun | | **ritrovai** | verb, 1st‑person singular, simple past *ritrovare* “to find again, to discover” | *found* | The act of discovering or realizing one’s own state | Main verb (finite) | | **per** | preposition “through, within” | *within* | Indicates interior location inside something | Preposition | | **una** | indefinite article, feminine singular “a” | *a* | Introduces a non‑specific noun | Article | | **selva** | noun, feminine singular “forest, wood” | *wood* | A densely wooded area; here metaphorically dark and confusing | Noun (object of *per*) | | **oscura** | adjective, feminine singular “dark” | *dark* | Lacking light; conveys gloom and uncertainty | Adjective (modifies *selva*) | | **ché** | conjunction “because, for” (archaic *che*) | *for* | Introduces a causal clause explaining the previous state | Subordinating conjunction | | **la** | definite article, feminine singular “the” | *the* | Specifies the particular way being spoken of | Article | | **diritta** | adjective, feminine singular “right, straight” | *right* | Correct or proper; forms the passive perfect with *smarrita* | Auxiliary verb | | **smarrita** | past participle, feminine singular of *smarrire* “to lose, to miss” | *missed* | The state of being lost or not found; here the correct way is absent | Past participle (part of passive construction) |

**2️⃣ Interpretation Lock (truth‑conditions)**
- **Line 1** – *Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita* - **Locked Meaning:** At the temporal point that divides the speaker’s lifespan into two equal halves, the speaker is situated on the metaphorical road that represents the course of that life. - **Formal condition:** ∃t [ t = midpoint(lifespan(speaker)) ∧ on(speaker, road(life(speaker)), t) ].
- **Line 2** – *mi ritrovai per una selva oscura* - **Locked Meaning:** The speaker discovers that his/her location is inside a forest that possesses the property of darkness. - **Formal condition:** located(speaker, forest) ∧ dark(forest) ∧ self‑realization(speaker, “I am inside a dark forest”).
- **Line 3** – *ché la diritta via era smarrita* - **Locked Meaning:** The correct (right) path that should have been followed is no longer present; it has been lost or omitted. - **Formal condition:** ¬exists(via_correct) ∧ lost(via_correct) ∧ causal(“for”, line 2’s situation).
*No comparative or degree constructions appear in these three lines; therefore no subject‑comparator‑relation statements are required.*
